# opnsense_interfaces_gif (Resource)

Manages an OPNsense GIF tunnel interface.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `description` (String) Optional description.
- `disable_ingress_filtering` (Boolean) Disable outer-source ingress filtering for asymmetric routing.
- `ecn_friendly` (Boolean) Enable ECN-friendly behaviour.
- `local_address` (String) Outer local endpoint: logical interface, CARP/IP Alias selector, or IP address.
- `remote_address` (String) Outer remote IP address.
- `tunnel_local_address` (String) Inner local tunnel address.
- `tunnel_remote_address` (String) Inner remote tunnel address.
- `tunnel_remote_prefix` (Number) Inner remote network prefix length.

### Read-Only

- `device` (String) Automatically allocated GIF device name.
- `id` (String) UUID of the GIF configuration.
